note: Corn chips baked with shredded chicken, black beans and cheese

steps.text: Drain the beans and grate the cheese.
Spread the chips on a tray and top with chicken, beans and cheese.
Bake at 200C.
Finish with salsa and sour cream.

note: Dark rye squares with creme fraiche, smoked salmon, dill and lemon

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the rye into neat squares and pick the dill into sprigs.
Spread with creme fraiche.
Top with a fold of salmon, a sprig of dill and a squeeze of lemon.
Lay out in sharp rows on black slate.

note: Grilled franks in soft buns with yellow mustard and warm sauerkraut

steps.text: Warm the sauerkraut with the caraway seeds.
Grill the franks until they split.
Tuck into buns with mustard and sauerkraut and wrap in wax paper.

note: Steamed pork, prawn and ginger dumplings

steps.text: Peel and chop the prawns. Mix with the pork, ginger and soy.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam in a lined bamboo basket.
Serve hot with soy sauce and chilli oil.

note: Crusty bread filled with brie, ham and tomato chutney, cut into small pieces

dish.n: Brie, ham and chutney sandwich bites

steps.text: Split the bread and fill with sliced brie, ham and chutney.
Cut into small pieces and pin with toothpicks.
Serve on a board with a bowl of green olives.

note: Lobster in lemon chive mayo piled into toasted mini brioche buns

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Chop the lobster meat and chives. Zest the lemon.
Toss the lobster with mayonnaise, zest and chives.
Split and toast the brioche buns.
Pile in the lobster and dust with paprika.

note: Sponge soaked in sherry, raspberry jelly, custard and whipped cream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Cube the sponge and press into a glass bowl, then splash with sherry.
Make up the jelly and pour over the sponge.
Chill until set.
Spoon over the custard and top with whipped cream.
Chill overnight and top with raspberries.

note: Smoked salmon blinis, and asparagus spears wrapped in crisp prosciutto

steps.text: Trim the asparagus and blanch for a minute.
Blanch.
Wrap each spear in prosciutto and grill until crisp.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, salmon and dill.
Arrange both on trays.

note: Oatcakes with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and lemon

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Spread the oatcakes with cream cheese.
Top with folds of salmon and a sprig of dill.
Squeeze over a little lemon and lay on a slate.

note: Toasted baguette with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and lemon zest

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the baguette and toast until golden.
Spread with cream cheese and top with folds of smoked salmon.
Scatter with capers and a little lemon zest, then serve.

note: Rye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and capers

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Spread the crispbreads with cream cheese.
Top with folds of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a few capers.
Squeeze over a little lemon just before serving.

note: Crab, cream cheese and spring onion baked until golden and bubbling

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake just before serving

steps.text: Slice the spring onions and mix with the crab, cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Spread in a small dish and bake at 190C until golden and bubbling.
Serve hot with water crackers.

note: Chicken grilled in a coconut milk, turmeric and lemongrass marinade, peanut sauce

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

ingredients.item: chicken thigh fillets, cut into strips
coconut milk, extra for the sauce

steps.text: Chop the lemongrass finely and mix with the coconut milk and turmeric. Add the chicken, which is the start of the marinating.
Marinate in the fridge.
Soak the skewers in water, then thread on the chicken.
Grill until charred and cooked through.
Warm the peanut butter with the extra coconut milk, lime juice and sugar into a thick dipping sauce.

note: Pork mince, wombok, ginger and spring onion dumplings

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, freeze uncooked

steps.text: Salt the wombok, squeeze out the water, then mix with the pork, ginger, sliced spring onion and salt.
Fold spoonfuls of filling into the wrappers around the table together.
Boil in batches until they float, then a minute more.
Serve with black vinegar for dipping.

film: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days (2003)
note: Fried risotto balls with peas, ham and parmesan

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, or freeze

steps.text: Cook the rice with the hot stock, added a ladle at a time, into a firm risotto.
Stir through the peas, ham and parmesan, then spread out and cool.
Roll into 16 balls and crumb in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden.
Warm the marinara and serve alongside.

note: Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips and baked

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the franks briefly and drain well.
Cut the pastry into strips and roll one around each frank.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C until golden.
Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

note: Fresh shucked oysters on crushed ice with an eschalot and cracked pepper dressing

dish.make_ahead: Shuck just before serving

steps.text: Finely dice the eschalots and stir into the vinegar with the cracked pepper.
Lay the oysters on crushed ice.
Spoon a little dressing over each and serve with lemon wedges.

note: Crisp baked wings tossed in a sticky honey, soy and garlic glaze

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in a hot oven

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt and bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the honey, soy sauce and crushed garlic until sticky.
Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.

note: Vanilla bean custard in ramekins beside raspberry jelly cups

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, torch just before serving

steps.text: Make up the jelly as the packet says and set in small cups.
Heat the cream with the split vanilla bean, whisk into the yolks and sugar, then strain into ramekins.
Bake in a water bath at 150C until just set.
Chill the custards until firm.
Sprinkle with sugar, torch and serve with the jelly.

note: Crab cakes with mayo, Dijon and spring onion, pan fried

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the crab with the mayonnaise, Dijon, sliced spring onion and breadcrumbs.
Shape into small cakes and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Pan-fry until golden on both sides.
Serve with lemon wedges.

note: Cubed tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice in small cups

dish.make_ahead: Best made fresh, keep chilled up to 2 hours

steps.text: Rinse and cook the sushi rice, then cool.
Cube the tuna and toss with soy sauce, sesame oil and sliced spring onion.
Spoon the rice into small cups and top with the tuna. Serve chilled.

note: Cubed tuna in soy and sesame oil with spring onion, on rice crackers

dish.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 hour ahead, top the crackers just before serving

steps.text: Cut the tuna into small cubes.
Toss with soy sauce, sesame oil and sliced spring onion.
Spoon onto rice crackers just before serving so they stay crisp.

note: Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, figs with goat's cheese and honey

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Top the blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and snipped chives.
Halve the figs and top each with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey.
Arrange both in neat rows on a platter.

note: Popcorn bound with melted marshmallow, sour straps and jelly beans

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight

ingredients.item: butter, plus extra for your hands

steps.text: Pop the kernels and tip into a big bowl, discarding any unpopped kernels.
Melt the butter over low heat, add the marshmallows and stir until smooth.
Pour over the popcorn with the sour straps and jelly beans and fold quickly.
With buttered hands, press into 12 tennis ball sized rounds.
Set on baking paper until firm, which is the resting time.
Wrap each in cellophane.

note: Fried risotto ovals with a mozzarella centre

dish.make_ahead: Make the risotto the day before, fry just before serving

steps.text: Cook the rice into a risotto with the hot stock and parmesan. Spread out and chill, ideally overnight.
Roll into ovals around a cube of mozzarella.
Coat in beaten egg and panko.
Fry at 180C until golden.
Warm the napoli sauce and serve alongside.

note: Devilled eggs with a Dijon mayo yolk, crispy pancetta, smoked paprika

dish.n: Speakeasy devilled eggs with crispy pancetta
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled, top with pancetta just before serving

steps.text: Boil the eggs hard, cool in iced water, peel and halve.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and a pinch of paprika until smooth. Pipe back into the whites.
Bake the pancetta on a tray at 200C until crisp, cool and break into shards.
Top each egg with pancetta, a dusting of paprika and snipped chives.

note: Prawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, served on ice

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: green prawns, raw and shell on

steps.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices.
Poach the prawns until pink, then plunge into iced water.
Peel the prawns.
Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce, a squeeze of lemon and hot sauce. Serve the prawns on ice with the sauce.

note: Buttered white bread with ham, cheddar and yellow mustard

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled and wrapped

steps.text: Butter the bread and fill with ham, cheddar and a stripe of mustard.
Cut in halves and wrap each in wax paper.

note: Toasted baguette: brie with fig jam, and Dijon with folded ham

dish.n: Brie, fig jam and ham baguette toasts
dish.make_ahead: Assemble just before serving

steps.text: Slice the baguette and toast until golden.
Top half with brie and fig jam.
Spread the rest with Dijon and top with folded ham.
Lay out on a wooden board.

note: Baguette slices with crab, cream cheese and spring onion, grilled

dish.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day, grill fresh

steps.text: Mix the crab with the cream cheese, mayonnaise, lemon zest and sliced spring onion.
Slice the baguette and spread the mix on each slice.
Grill until golden at the edges. Serve hot.

note: Beef and pork meatballs baked with parmesan, warm brown sugar tomato sauce

dish.n: Baked meatballs with sweet tomato sauce
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in the oven

steps.text: Mix the mince with the parmesan, breadcrumbs and egg. Roll into small balls.
Bake at 200C until cooked through.
Warm the tomato sauce with brown sugar until sticky and toss the meatballs through.
Serve on toothpicks.

note: Mini pepperoni and mozzarella pizzas baked crisp, oregano on top

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Roll the dough thin and cut into small rounds.
Top each with sauce, mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and a pinch of oregano.
Bake at 220C until crisp and bubbling.

note: Jalapeño halves stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon

dish.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Halve the jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds.
Mix the cream cheese with the cheddar and fill each half.
Wrap each half with half a rasher of bacon.
Bake at 200C until the bacon is crisp.

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

ingredients.item: bottles Mexican style lager (330 ml each)

steps.text: Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip into the salt. Fill with ice.
Into each glass add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire.
Top slowly with cold lager, stir gently and add a lime wedge. Use soda water instead of beer for anyone not drinking.

note: Pepperoni and mozzarella pizza baked crisp on a tray

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Stretch the dough thin on a tray.
Spread with sauce and scatter with mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.
Bake at 250C until bubbling.
Cut and put back in a box.

note: Grilled franks in soft buns with slow-fried onions and yellow mustard

dish.make_ahead: Onions up to 1 day, grill franks fresh

steps.text: Slice the onions and fry slowly until soft and golden.
Grill the franks until they split.
Tuck into soft buns with the onions and mustard and wrap in paper.

film: To All the Boys I've Loved Before (2018)
note: Marshmallows dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed peppermint

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight

steps.text: Melt the chocolate.
Dip the marshmallows halfway and roll the chocolate end in crushed peppermint lollies.
Set on baking paper.

note: Rice cups with soy beef, spinach, carrot, fried egg and gochujang

dish.make_ahead: Components up to 1 day, assemble fresh

steps.text: Cook the rice. Julienne the carrots.
Cook the beef with soy and garlic.
Saute the spinach and carrot separately.
Fry the eggs.
Spoon rice into small bowls, arrange the beef and vegetables on top with an egg and a dot of gochujang. Mix it all up before eating.

note: Twice-fried wings tossed in a sticky gochujang and honey glaze

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh, reheat in a hot oven

steps.text: Fry the wings at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crackly.
Warm the gochujang with honey and crushed garlic until glossy.
Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds.

note: Chilled cooked prawns on ice with lemon and spicy cocktail sauce

dish.n: Huntsman in the pants harbour prawns
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep on ice

steps.text: Pile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange the prawns on top with lemon wedges.
Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce and hot sauce.
Serve in a bowl beside the prawns.

note: Mini beef mince pies with puff lids, served with tomato sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in the oven

steps.text: Dice the onion and brown with the mince.
Stir in the flour and stock and simmer until thick, then cool.
Cut the shortcrust into rounds and line a muffin tin. Fill with the mince and top with puff lids.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C until golden.
Serve with tomato sauce.

note: Chicken thigh skewers marinated in coconut and turmeric, peanut sauce

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

ingredients.item: chicken thigh fillets, cut into strips

steps.text: Chop the lemongrass and mix with the coconut milk and turmeric. Add the chicken and marinate in the fridge.
Soak the skewers in water, then thread on the chicken.
Grill until charred and cooked through.
Warm the peanut butter with the extra coconut milk and lime juice into a thick sauce.

note: Puffed prawn crackers fried crisp, sweet chilli sauce for dipping

dish.make_ahead: Crackers keep a day in an airtight tin

steps.text: Heat the oil to 190C.
Drop in the prawn crackers a few at a time. They puff up in seconds. Scoop out and drain on paper.
Pile into a big bowl with sweet chilli sauce for dipping.

note: Buttered brown bread with smoked salmon, capers, lemon and black pepper

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Spread the bread thickly with butter.
Top with folds of smoked salmon, a few capers and a crack of pepper.
Squeeze over a little lemon and cut into triangles.

note: Grilled franks in soft buns with yellow mustard and pickle relish

dish.n: Hit Bull Win Steak ballpark franks
dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Grill the franks until they split and blister.
Tuck each into a soft bun with a stripe of mustard and a spoon of relish.
Wrap tightly in paper so the bun steams.

note: Thick bacon baked crisp, with maple syrup on the side

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Lay the bacon on a rack over a tray.
Bake at 200C until crisp.
Cut into pieces and serve warm with a small bowl of maple syrup for dipping.

note: Toast squares topped with scrambled egg, crisp bacon and chives

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp and chop.
Scramble the eggs softly in butter.
Toast the bread, cut into small squares and top each with egg, bacon and snipped chives.

note: Cocktail franks in cornmeal batter, deep fried on skewers, mustard

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and buttermilk to a thick batter.
Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each.
Dip in the batter and fry at 180C in batches.
Serve with mustard.

note: the father and son fishing move, Lake Destiny in Idaho

dish.make_ahead: Crumb up to 4 hours ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the fish into fingers and crumb them in flour, egg, then panko.
Stir the mayonnaise with the pickles and capers for the tartare.
Fry in batches at 180C for about 3 minutes until golden, then drain.
Serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.

note: Max telling everyone he'll be on stage at the Powerline concert

dish.make_ahead: Mince and salsa up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Brown the mince with the onion.
Add the taco spice, black beans and water and simmer.
Spread the corn chips on a large tray, spoon over the mince and cover with cheddar, then bake until melted.
Mash the avocados with lime and salt, dice the tomatoes with coriander, and top the nachos with guacamole, salsa and sour cream.

note: Bigfoot helps himself to everything at the campsite

dish.make_ahead: Best made fresh

steps.text: Toast the marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under a hot grill until golden.
Squash each between two biscuits with a square of milk chocolate and leave 30 seconds so the chocolate starts to melt.

note: Thick chips under beef gravy and melted mozzarella

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips, soak and dry well.
Fry at 150C, then again at 190C until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer until thick.
Pile the chips on a tray, pour over the gravy, cover with mozzarella and grill until melted.

note: Toasted bagel halves with pizza sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Split the bagels and toast lightly.
Spread each half with pizza sauce and top with mozzarella and pepperoni.
Grill until bubbling. Cut into halves to share.

note: Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon

dish.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Halve the jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds.
Mix the cream cheese with the cheddar and fill each half.
Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon.
Bake at 200C until the bacon is crisp.

note: Cocktail frankfurts heated gently and piled up with tomato sauce

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to a simmer.
Add the frankfurts and heat without boiling so the skins do not split.
Drain, pile into a bowl with toothpicks and serve with tomato sauce for dipping.

note: Pork, green apple and sage rolled in flaky puff pastry

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, or freeze

steps.text: Mix the sausage mince with the apple, onion and sage.
Roll into logs along the pastry sheets and roll up, then cut each into 6.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C until golden.
Rest briefly before serving.

note: Fish cured in lime juice, tossed with coconut cream and cucumber

dish.n: Samoan oka raw fish in coconut
dish.make_ahead: Make just before serving

steps.text: Cut the fish into 1cm cubes and cover with lime juice.
Chill until the fish turns white.
Dice the cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Drain most of the juice, then stir in the coconut cream and vegetables. Season and serve cold.

note: Crisp filo parcels of cinnamon and cumin spiced beef

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, bake fresh

steps.text: Fry the mince with the onion, cinnamon, cumin and salt until browned, then stir in the coriander. Cool.
Cut the filo into long strips and brush with melted butter.
Add a spoonful of filling to each strip and fold into triangles.
Bake at 190C until crisp.

note: Dijon, sliced ham and Swiss cheese on rye, cut in quarters

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep covered

steps.text: Spread the rye slices with Dijon.
Fill 4 with ham and Swiss cheese and close.
Cut each into quarters and stack on a plate.

note: Prunes stuffed with almonds, wrapped in bacon and baked crisp

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, bake fresh

steps.text: Push an almond into each prune.
Wrap each in a third of a bacon rasher and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C until the bacon is crisp.

note: Crisp rolls of pork mince, cabbage and carrot seasoned with soy

dish.make_ahead: Fill a day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Fry the mince until browned, then add the cabbage and carrot and cook until soft, seasoning with soy. Cool.
Roll tablespoons of filling into the wrappers and seal with water.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce and soy.

note: Milk chocolate with marshmallows, peanuts and broken biscuits

dish.make_ahead: Up to 5 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the chocolate gently.
Stir in the marshmallows, peanuts and broken biscuits.
Spread into a lined 20cm tin.
Chill until set, which is the setting time.
Cut into rough rocks.

note: Silky chicken liver pâté and smashed broad beans on toasted baguette

dish.n: Chicken liver pâté with broad beans
dish.make_ahead: Pate up to 2 days chilled, assemble fresh

steps.text: Fry the shallot in butter, add the livers and thyme and cook until just pink inside.
Blitz with the softened butter until smooth and chill.
Boil the broad beans, peel and smash with oil and salt.
Serve both on toasted baguette slices.

note: Puff pastry cases filled with creamy chicken and mushroom

steps.text: Fry the diced chicken breast in butter, add the sliced mushrooms, then stir in the flour and the cream and simmer until thick.
Warm the vol-au-vent cases at 180C for 5 minutes, fill them and pass around on a tray.

film: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery (2022)
note: Hummus, tzatziki, olives, cherry tomatoes and warm pita

steps.text: Blitz the drained chickpeas with the tahini, the garlic clove, lemon and ice water until smooth.
Mix the Greek yoghurt with half a grated cucumber, garlic and salt for tzatziki.
Lay both out with the kalamata olives, cherry tomatoes and the warm pita breads.

film: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery (2022)
note: Crisp baked wings tossed in homemade red chilli and garlic sauce

steps.text: Toss the chicken wings with the baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once.
Blitz the red chillies with the garlic cloves, the vinegar and the honey, simmer 5 minutes and toss through the wings.
Serve with celery and the blue cheese stirred into the sour cream.

note: Pan-fried then steamed, with black vinegar and chilli oil

steps.text: Mix the pork mince with the finely chopped cabbage, the soy sauce and the sesame oil.
Fill the dumpling wrappers and pleat closed.
Fry flat side down until golden, add the water, cover and steam 6 minutes.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

note: King prawns in pink cocktail sauce, served in small cups

steps.text: Peel and devein the cooked king prawns, leaving a few tails on for the tops.
Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the Worcestershire, a few drops of hot sauce and the juice of half a lemon until pink and smooth.
Shred the cos heart and divide between the small glasses.
Add diced avocado and the prawns, spoon over the sauce, dust with paprika and add a lemon wedge.

note: Mini beef burgers with cheddar and charred green chilli

dish.n: Los Alamos green chile cheeseburger sliders

steps.text: Char the long green chillies over a flame or under a grill until blackened, sweat in a bowl, peel, seed and chop.
Roll the beef mince into balls.
Smash flat in a very hot pan, season and cook 2 minutes.
Flip, top with the chillies and a slice of cheddar each, cover 1 minute.
Mix the mayo with the chipotle in adobo.
Toast the slider buns and build with mayo, patties and pickles.

note: Pan-fried chorizo coins glazed with smoked paprika honey

dish.n: Bullet Farm chorizo with smoky honey

steps.text: Slice the chorizo sausages into 1.5cm coins.
Heat a heavy pan over high heat and fry without oil for 4 minutes, turning, until blistered and the fat runs.
Add the honey, the smoked paprika and the sherry vinegar and toss for 1 minute until sticky.
Grill the slices of sourdough until charred.
Serve the chorizo on toothpicks with the bread to mop up the pan juices.

note: Chilled king prawns, horseradish cocktail sauce, buttered white bread

steps.text: Pile the cooked king prawns on crushed ice with lemon wedges.
Mix the tomato sauce with the horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve with buttered white bread, the way you would on the harbour.

note: Grilled sausages in buttered bread with beer onion relish

steps.text: Slowly cook the sliced onions in the butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the brown sugar, the balsamic and the beer and simmer 5 minutes until jammy.
Grill the thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Butter the slices of white bread, wrap each round a sausage and top with the onion relish, mustard and tomato sauce.

note: Grilled sandwiches of thick-cut marmalade, ham and cheddar

steps.text: Butter the slices of thick white bread on one side.
Spread the thick-cut marmalade on the unbuttered sides, then add the sliced ham and the grated vintage cheddar.
Close with the other slices, butter side out.
Cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into squares.
